summary: Bentley Systems filed an 8-K on September 11, 2026, announcing that its board declared a $0.07 per share quarterly cash dividend on both Class A and Class B common stock, payable September 29, 2026, to holders of record at the close of business on September 22, 2026. The press release was furnished as Exhibit 99.1. No advisor, premium, or transaction mechanics were disclosed, as this is an ordinary recurring capital-return declaration rather than a tender, buyback, or special distribution. Watch for future board determinations on dividends and repurchases, which remain contingent on financial condition.
